description_en: Retrieves the count of automated response rules
description_zh: 获取自动化响应规则计数
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-response-rule-statistic --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetResponseRuleStatistic

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Specify this parameter based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China)
ap-southeast-1: regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: the current Alibaba Cloud account view.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

ResponseStatistic.description_en: The statistics of automated response rules

ResponseRuleAllCount.description_en: The total number of automated response rules
ResponseRuleAllCount.description_zh: 自动化响应规则全部数量

ResponseRuleOnlineCount.description_en: The number of online automated response rules
ResponseRuleOnlineCount.description_zh: 自动化响应规则在线数量
